title: SAIHM -03 × 保留/删除义务交叉映射 · 锚点规格（示例）
note: 换协议就改 source/start/end/must；判定逻辑不在本文件里，只在被引的原文里。

checks.claim: 期限只在运营方声明里
must: a named, operator-chosen persistence class with stated durability and retention properties
Tier names carry no protocol semantics

checks.claim: 单元元组无期限字段
must: tier: short ASCII string naming the storage tier

checks.claim: 旧 cellId 可重算，故不可静默覆盖
must: recompute cellId
MUST refuse to serve a cell whose stored cellId does not match
SHA-256

checks.claim: 无 reason/actor/supersession 字段
must: cellId, holderId, kekVersion, tier, cellNonce, ciphertext, signature, timestamp

checks.claim: 身份由 ML-DSA-65 公钥绑定
must: holderId: 32-byte holder identifier: the SHA-256 digest of the holder

checks.claim: 删除可被任何观察者重建
must: write a FORGET receipt for the cellId to the audit log
a public, append-only set of erased cellIds
MUST NOT return an erased cell to anyone

checks.claim: 删除类别只在运营方文档可读
must: MUST state in its published documentation which class it provides
Clients MUST NOT assert either class

checks.claim: destructionAnchor 在工具返回面
must: returns it as destructionAnchor

checks.claim: FORGET 收据可按四键检索
must: list entries by subjectId, by holderId and by operation
every FORGET receipt
check the receipt's signature against the holder's public key

checks.claim: 收据体系无边界字段
must: receiptId, subjectId, operation, holderId, signature, timestamp, receiptNonce

checks.claim: HIPAA 6 年、起算取较晚者
must: for 6 years from the date of its creation or the date when it last was in effect, whichever is later

checks.claim: PIPEDA 只留必要 + 要求给上下限
must: retained only as long as necessary for the fulfilment of those purposes
minimum and maximum retention periods

checks.claim: PIPL 最短必要 + 停止处理 + 三年
must: 实现处理目的所必要的最短时间
停止除存储和采取必要的安全保护措施之外的处理
至少保存三年

checks.claim: LGPD 第 16 条与第 37 条
must: Art. 16
Art. 37

checks.claim: GDPR 删除须无不当迟延
must: the erasure of personal data concerning him or her without undue delay

checks.claim: GDPR 可携带格式与传输
must: structured, commonly used and machine-readable format
transmit those data to another controller

checks.claim: PIPL 可携带须提供转移途径
must: 转移至其指定的个人信息处理者

checks.claim: 我方提出的一句话已原样进入 charter v1.1 §2
must: re-examines that deliverable as a decision under §9
rather than leaving it pinned to a text that no longer says what it said

checks.claim: v1.1 自述 §3 范围未改
must: Scope (§3) is unchanged

checks.claim: §3 仍点名可比法域清单
must: comparable regimes (HIPAA, PIPEDA, PIPL, LGPD)

checks.claim: v1.1 正文不含 medical device 措辞
W3C Team 通知确认 v1.1 于 2026-11-23 通过
must: Status: v1.1 — Adopted on 2026-11-23

checks.claim: §3 把 crosswalk 写为 informative 的第 4 项
must: A regulatory crosswalk pack (informative): mappings from the referenced protocol

checks.claim: §5 交付物清单：informative，映射即 §3 所列
must: Regulatory crosswalk pack (informative) — the mappings enumerated in §3

checks.claim: 协议承认运营方仍负无不当迟延的删除责任
must: remain responsible for erasure without undue delay
